## Brief
Make `npm run web:fixtures` (scripts/web-fixtures.js) publish one catalog entry marked `anonymous`, so guest mode's download door (BAD-002) is testable in the dev loop without the hand step `node scripts/showcase.mjs mark fixture-dub-scene-me8horfs0000 --anonymous --out web/scenes` after every regeneration.

Change: pass `anonymous` to publishScene per fixture — true for the fixture whose directory name starts with `fixture-dub-scene`, false for the rest (explicit false, so the generated index is fully determined). Keep the run deterministic: two runs must still write byte-identical output. Update the header comment of scripts/web-fixtures.js to say which entry is marked and why; add a sentence to web/CLAUDE.md where it describes the mark (around the `npm run showcase -- publish --anonymous` sentence) only if that section needs it to stay true.

Setup: this is a fresh worktree — run `bash scripts/worktree-init.sh` first. Follow the repo's .claude/skills/implementing-changes skill for what proves the change. At minimum: run `npm run web:fixtures` twice, confirm web/scenes/index.json has exactly one entry with `anonymous: true` (the dub scene) and the rest false, and that the two runs' trees are byte-identical (e.g. compare a hash listing); then `npm test`. If the skill calls for a unit test, add test/web-fixtures.test.js (it must not leave web/scenes dirty or depend on real voicepacks). web/scenes/ is gitignored; do not commit anything.
